Fibres start with cable types. Open the Device Builder on the Cables tab.
A cable type has a medium, a number of cores, a connector at both ends, and a length. Half metres are fine, like seven point five.
OpticalCON, FiberFox and SFP patch cables each have their own connector. A cable only fits ports with the same connector. Click save.
On the Network page, on the Fibres tab, enter how many of each cable you own. The stock is counted for you.
Auto-assign chains the switches inside a DB with the short cable, and links the DB's with the long cable, as a ring or a chain.
It tells you if the stock is not enough, and which connectors are missing. Press Assign, and the links are made.
The list shows every fibre, with its two ends. Remove one, and the cable goes back into the stock.
